additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: AW: ID0484829-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2 / S5 313688776001] Charger issue CRM:03432000032
additional_info.body:
Dear Alexander,
As you can see below after the transaction started we sent the command to OCPP with that following ID Tag, and it got status invalid.
This means that OCPP is blocking the ID tag for some reason. Most likely either it doesn't acknowledge it or its blocked on purpose.
As you can see we are reaching P06_Charge so there is nothing wrong with the energy transfer process.
Please ask the OCPP backend why did the ID tag get rejected.
Best regards,
Miguel Caleiro
